title: Epik PVP Pack
description: This is my Custom resourcepack for the pvp montages or for pvp itself!
body:
# This is the Epik PvP Pack!
You can do PvP with this texture pack, or use it in the Vanilla world.

# The features
This pack just doesnt change textures, but also adds satisfying sounds to the Vanilla world or the PvP world!

# Any feedback is appreciated!
